# Tay Marais

> Contemporary romance author. Dual POV, slow burn, celebrity romance, with
> themes of healing, identity and recovery. The site is bilingual: English and
> Brazilian Portuguese, every page paired with its counterpart.

Site: https://taymarais.com/

## Books

- [Where the Ocean Ends](https://taymarais.com/books/where-the-ocean-ends.html): Adam Walker has the world at feet, an Oscar on his shelf, and a deafening void in his chest. After a devastating divorce that plastered his personal life across every tabloid cover, the Hollywood star flees into the shadows of Los Angeles in search of anonymity. He wanted to disappear. He just didn't expect to find her. She is Madeleine Bennett, France's "L'Ange Blond", a prodigy heiress living under suffocating surveillance. Series starter, HFN ending. The opening chapter is readable in full on the page, and the first two chapters are offered as a free ebook, EPUB and PDF, by email.
- [Onde o Oceano Acaba](https://taymarais.com/pt/books/onde-o-oceano-acaba.html): the same book in Brazilian Portuguese, with the same opening chapter and the same free sample.

## Pages

- [Contact](https://taymarais.com/contact.html): message form, answered by the author.
- [Contato](https://taymarais.com/pt/contact.html): the Portuguese version of the same form.
- [Privacy](https://taymarais.com/privacy.html): what the site collects, why, and how to have it deleted.

## Content notes

Where the Ocean Ends contains detailed intimacy, swearing, and themes of trauma
recovery, past abuse, and substance use. Recommended for mature readers.
